title: lichend TOML config silently ignores unknown keys (no deny_unknown_fields)
description: Found in 3x codereview of w0fp (robustness pass). Config structs in rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs (Config:14-30, GatewayCoordinationConfig:43-61, SecurityConfig:33-40) use #[serde(default)] without deny_unknown_fields, so a typo'd key such as master_salt (instead of master_salt_hex) or rollback_floor is silently dropped. Worst case: mode=psk starts without the intended master salt, deriving different per-peer OSCORE contexts than every other federation member (silent interop outage, fail-open-ish); misspelled psk_hex/peer_public_keys do fail closed via EmptyPeers/missing-psk. Add #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to the public config structs (verify no existing deployment TOMLs rely on extra keys) and add a regression test that an unknown key under [gateway_coordination]/[security] is rejected. Related docs already shipped in deploy/lichend.toml.example.
